source_evidence: Some companies allow you to buy or sell their stock directly through them without using a broker.
answer: A direct stock plan (DSP) lets you buy or sell a participating company’s stock through the company rather than through a broker. This may save on commissions, but the plan can still charge other fees. DSPs usually trade at set times and an average market price, so you generally cannot choose a specific trading time or market price. Plans may also have eligibility rules or minimums. Read the plan’s rules and fees before investing.
